lede: The most consequential meeting this week is SMART's August 13 board session, where two resolutions go to a vote: one restructuring the Gondola Advisory Committee — the body overseeing the voter-approved $5.2M/year gondola tax — and one assigning professional responsibilities for that ongoing project. San Miguel County's Planning Commission also meets Thursday on a subdivision work session and an energy code update that would change building standards for new construction. Ridgway holds a public hearing on the Hyde Subdivision replatting and a joint session on its state-mandated Housing Action Plan, and the Mushroom Festival is in full swing at venues around town.
